messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated gateway 5xx rate detected for us-west-2 (5m avg 4.8%). Paging @maya oncall.

maya: On it — digging in. seeing a pattern of timeouts and 502s from upstream provider 'edge-broker-a'.

aj: I can see increased downstream latency in traces, spans show repeated retries before 502. likely upstream causing connection resets.

sam: Customer Impact: several apps show >2% user-facing errors. Support already flagged a few customers.

lucas: I'm going to flip the fallback routing to prefer us-east for affected routes to reduce error surface. patching now.

lucas: ```bash
# temporary routing change
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-routing
  namespace: prod
data:
  prefer_region: us-east-1
EOF
```

maya: Routing change applied, starting to see a drop in 5xx on the gateway at the edge layer. p95 latency for edge -> upstream is still high though.

aj: Running a quick probe to upstream provider to confirm health: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://edge-broker-a.prod/api/health` -> responses flickering 502/524.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment detected for gateway v2.1.3 at 3055554300. No obvious correlation but noting for postmortem.

sam: For paging noise: current alert is firing for any >1% 5xx in 1m window. That's too sensitive for small blips. Propose adjust to 3% over 5m and add a suppression rule for transient provider retries.

maya: Agreed. For now I'm adding a temporary silence on the existing 1m alert so we don't page repeatedly while we stabilize.

maya: ```yaml
# temporary alert silence
alert_name: gateway-5xx-high
silence_until: 3055554999
reason: ongoing mitigation and routing fallback
```

aj: Follow-up tasks: (1) add a dashboard tile: gateway -> upstream p95 latency by provider, (2) create an alert variant that only pages if 5xx>3% AND customers_impacted>5%, (3) add runbook steps to failover regional routing.

lucas: I'll own creating the dashboard. planning to surface p50/p95/p99 and request volume alongside provider error rate.

sam: I'll draft the alert change and open a PR for alertmanager rules. We'll review in post-incident review.

maya: Handing to @aj for longer-term remediation and postmortem. leaving notes in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

aj: Taking over. Will coordinate with provider ops to get more context and timeline, and then schedule alert tuning + dashboard work into the SRE board.

incidents-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated; summary=Routing fallback reduced customer errors; next=postmortem+alert-tuning.

maya: Thanks team — good quick mitigation. leaving oncall.

aj: Thanks, looping in provider contact and shuffling to follow-up queue.
